title: One-pot-synthesized anthracene-based chemodosimeter for toxic cyanide (CN−) detection and anticancer analysis: substantiated by DFT, real-time investigations, and cytotoxicity assays
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,16167-16180
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00024J, Paper

Muthaiah Shellaiah, Wen-Tai Li, Phamdom Romabai Chanu, Richard Lam, Arumugam Murugan, Basheer Aazaad, Ming-Chang Lin, K. Anandan, Mayank Bhushan
A one-pot-synthesized anthracene derivative with potential anticancer activity has been reported as a probe for CN− detection via a 1,4 addition reaction.
